item.title: Prime Minister Kim Min-seok to Visit China from 22nd to 24th, Attend Summer Davos Forum (김민석 총리, 22~24일 중국 방문… 하계 다보스 포럼 참석)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok to Visit China from 22nd to 24th, Attend Summer Davos Forum (김민석 총리, 22~24일 중국 방문… 하계 다보스 포럼 참석)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok will visit China from the 22nd to the 24th, delivering a special speech at the Summer Davos Forum and discussing current issues with high-level Chinese officials. (김민석 국무총리가 오는 22~24일 중국을 방문해 하계 다보스포럼에서 특별 연설을 하고 중국 고위급 인사와 현안을 논의한다.)

The Prime Minister’s Office announced on the 19th that Kim will visit Beijing and Dalian, China, for a three-day, two-night trip at the invitation of the Chinese government and the World Economic Forum (WEF). (국무총리실은 19일 김 총리가 중국 및 세계경제포럼(WEF) 측의 초청으로 중국 베이징과 다롄을 2박 3일간 방문한다고 밝혔다.)

Kim is scheduled to hold meetings with high-level Chinese officials and attend events related to the economy and veterans affairs. (김 총리는 중국 고위급 인사와의 회담, 경제 및 보훈 관련 일정을 소화할 예정이다.)

item.title: Joo Jin-woo: "82.1% of NEC Contracts Over Five Years Were Non-Competitive" (주진우 “선관위 5년간 계약 중 82.1%가 수의계약”)
item.description:
Joo Jin-woo: "82.1% of NEC Contracts Over Five Years Were Non-Competitive" (주진우 “선관위 5년간 계약 중 82.1%가 수의계약”)

Joo Jin-woo, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, announced on the 19th that "a full analysis of 2,665 contracts made by the National Election Commission over the past five years shows that 82.1% were non-competitive contracts." (주진우 국민의힘 의원은 “중앙선거관리위원회의 지난 5년간 계약 2665건을 전수 분석한 결과 82.1%가 수의 계약이었다”고 19일 밝혔다.)

Holding a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Rep. Joo stated, "We should call it the Non-Competitive Contract Commission, not the National Election Commission." (주 의원은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “선관위가 아니라 수의계약위원회라고 불러야 한다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

He added, "Last year in particular, the proportion of non-competitive contracts reached 87.7%. I have never seen such a high share of non-competitive contracts. This is an abnormal practice." (주 의원은 “특히 작년은 수의계약 비율이 87.7%에 달했다”면서 “이렇게 수의계약 비중이 높은 것은 처음 본다. 비정상적 행태”라고 했다.)

Joo argued, "Non-competitive contracts carry a high risk of collusion with specific companies and potential favoritism, so their amounts are strictly limited. But the NEC, wielding unchecked power, disregarded those limits as if they didn't matter. The NEC has become a monstrous institution that hires the children of its employees at will, travels abroad freely, and deals with preferred companies without restraint." (주 의원은 “수의계약은 특정 업체와 유착될 가능성이 높고 특혜가 될 수 있어 금액이 엄격히 제한된다”면서 “선관위는 무소불위의 권력을 누리면서 그런 제한도 아랑곳하지 않았다. 선관위는 말 그대로 직원 자녀를 뽑고 싶으면 뽑고, 해외 가고 싶으면 가고, 특정 업체와 거래하고 싶으면 거래하는 괴물 기관이 됐다”고 했다.)

He further noted that an analysis of public data on the top 10 companies receiving non-competitive contracts from the NEC revealed that figures such as former prosecutor general Shim Jae-chul, former Vice Minister of Justice Ko Ki-young, and former Secretary-General of the Korea Communications Commission Choi Seong-ho had served as outside directors with pro-Democratic Party leanings. Joo commented, "We need to investigate whether their role was to provide protection or for some lobbying purpose." He added, "I will thoroughly look into conflicts of interest involving these non-competitive contract companies, and whether current or former NEC employees or their acquaintances are employed there. I plan to select companies heavily involved in such contracts and request an investigation by the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission." (이어 선관위의 수의계약 상위 업체 10곳의 공개 자료를 분석한 결과 심재철 전 검사장, 고기영 전 법무차관, 최성호 전 방통위 사무처장 등 친민주당 성향 사외이사로 근무한 경력이 확인됐다며 “비호의 목적인지, 아니면 어떤 로비의 목적인지에 대해서도 규명이 필요하다”고 했다. 주 의원은 “수의계약 업체들의 이해충돌 여부, 선관위 전현직 직원 및 지인의 근무 여부 등을 철저히 파헤치겠다”면서 “수의계약 집중 업체들을 선별해 권익위원회에 조사를 의뢰하겠다”고 했다.)

Joo also emphasized the necessity of a special counsel, saying, "A special counsel is essential to expose the NEC's closed organizational culture, secrecy, collusion with specific companies, and the potential involvement of figures from the Democratic Party of Korea, without any sacred cows." (주 의원은 또 “선관위의 폐쇄적 조직 문화와 비밀주의, 특정 업체와의 유착, 나아가 더불어민주당 인사의 관여 여부를 성역 없이 밝히려면 특검은 필수적”이라며 특검 필요성을 강조했다.)

item.title: President Lee: Trump Asked, "Can You Rapidly Build 10 U.S. Warships?" (李대통령 “트럼프 ‘美 군함 10척 빠르게 건조해 줄 수 있나’ 요청”)
item.description:
President Lee: Trump Asked, "Can You Rapidly Build 10 U.S. Warships?" (李대통령 “트럼프 ‘美 군함 10척 빠르게 건조해 줄 수 있나’ 요청”)

<<>> Upon returning from a European tour and the G7 summit, President Lee Jae-myung announced in a briefing on the 19th that he received a request from U.S. President Donald Trump for the rapid construction of 10 U.S. warships. ()

President Lee reported that during a conversation with President Trump at the G7 summit, the two agreed on mutually beneficial cooperation plans, including in the shipbuilding sector. (유럽 순방과 G7 정상회의 일정을 마치고 귀국한 이재명 대통령이 19일 브리핑을 통해 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과의 회담에서 미국 군함 10척에 대한 신속한 건조 요청을 받았다고 밝혔다.)

Specifically, President Lee stated that President Trump specifically inquired, "Can you quickly build 10 U.S. warships?" In response, President Lee explained, "I answered that it is certainly possible and that we would do our utmost." This is not the first time President Trump has probed South Korea for warship construction. (이 대통령은 G7 정상회의 기간 중 진행된 트럼프 미 대통령과의 대화에서 조선(조선업) 분야를 포함한 양국의 호혜적인 협력 방안에 뜻을 모았다고 전했다.)

Additionally, the two leaders discussed the importance of U.S.-South Korea cooperation and trilateral cooperation with Japan in depth. President Lee said, "President Trump naturally emphasized the importance of U.S.-South Korea cooperation and U.S.-South Korea-Japan cooperation, and we expressed our agreement on that point." (특히 이 대통령은 트럼프 대통령이 “미국 군함 10척을 빠르게 건조해 줄 수 있겠느냐”며 구체적인 의사를 물어왔다고 밝혔다. 이에 대해 이 대통령은 “당연히 가능하고 최선을 다하겠다고 답해 드렸다”고 설명했다. 트럼프 대통령의 한국 행방 군함 건조 타진은 이번이 처음이 아니다.)

(아울러 두 정상은 한미 협력 및 한미일 협력의 중요성에 대해서도 심도 있게 논의했다. 이 대통령은 “트럼프 대통령께서 당연히 한미 협력, 또 한미일 협력의 중요성을 말씀하셨고 저희도 그 점에 공감을 표명했다”고 했다.)

President Lee also shared a special anecdote from the G7 meeting hall. He said, "French President Macron mentioned, 'I think there’s a lot to talk about, so I deliberately seated you next to President Trump.' I would like to take this opportunity to express my gratitude to President Macron." Thanks to this, President Lee explained that he was able to have "a deep conversation that enhanced mutual understanding" with President Trump. ()

Because of this consideration, President Lee had the opportunity to sit next to President Trump for over 90 minutes during the dinner, engaging in extended communication. President Lee reflected, "A truly deep conversation was possible, and it was actually much better than a formal summit meeting." (이 대통령은 G7 회의장에서 있었던 특별한 일화도 소개했다. 이 대통령은 “마크롱 프랑스 대통령이 ‘얘기할 거리가 많을 것 같아 일부러 트럼프 대통령과 자리를 붙여주었다’고 얘기했다”며 “이 자리를 빌려 마크롱 대통령에게 감사의 말씀을 드린다”고 전했다. 덕분에 트럼프 대통령과 “깊이 있는, 서로 이해를 깊이 하는 얘기를 나눴다”는 것이 이 대통령의 설명이다.)

President Lee also commented on President Trump’s reactions during the dinner. He said, "During that process, President Trump repeatedly called me a 'strong leader,' which I think is a sign of respect." (이러한 배려 덕분에 이 대통령은 만찬 자리에서 90분이 넘는 긴 시간 동안 트럼프 대통령의 옆자리에 앉아 소통할 기회를 가졌다. 이 대통령은 “정말 깊이 있는 대화가 가능했고, 오히려 정식 정상회담 시기보다 훨씬 더 나았던 것 같다”고 소회를 밝혔다.)

The core agenda discussed by the two leaders was security on the Korean Peninsula. President Lee emphasized, "The issues of the Korean Peninsula and U.S.-South Korea relations were the most important topics, and among them, the longest conversation we had was actually about the North Korean nuclear issue." (이 대통령은 만찬 중 트럼프 대통령이 보인 리액션에 대해서도 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “그 과정에서 트럼프 대통령이 나에게 ‘강한 지도자’라는 표현도 여러 차례 해주기도 하였는데, 아마 그게 존중의 의미라고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Trump Expressed Frustration with Resuming North Korea-U.S. Dialogue and Sought My Advice" (李대통령 “트럼프, 북미대화 재개 방안 답답해하며 내게 조언 구했다”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Trump Expressed Frustration with Resuming North Korea-U.S. Dialogue and Sought My Advice" (李대통령 “트럼프, 북미대화 재개 방안 답답해하며 내게 조언 구했다”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 19th during a briefing upon returning from his overseas trip that U.S. President Donald Trump expressed frustration about how to resume North Korea-U.S. dialogue and sought his advice, including specific solutions. President Lee said he advised that instead of sanctions and pressure, which have been ineffective for decades, a realistic alternative must be devised to halt North Korea's further nuclear development. (이재명 대통령은 19일 순방 귀국 브리핑에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 북미 대화 재개 방안에 대해 답답함을 토로하며 자신에게 구체적인 해결 방법 등 조언을 구했다고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 이에 대해 수십 년간 효과가 없었던 제재와 압박 대신, 북한의 추가 핵 개발을 중단시키는 현실 기반의 대안을 마련해야 한다고 조언했다고 전했다.)

President Lee revealed that the topic he discussed most extensively with President Trump during the G7 summit was the "North Korean nuclear issue," and he provided a detailed account of their conversation. Trump reportedly has the will to engage in dialogue with North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un but feels frustrated over the specific methodology and asked President Lee for his opinion. (이 대통령은 G7 정상회의 기간 중 트럼프 대통령과 가장 긴 대화를 나눈 주제가 ‘북핵 문제’였다고 밝히며 당시의 대화 내용을 상세히 전했다. 트럼프 대통령은 김정은 국무위원장과의 대화 의지는 가지고 있으나, 구체적인 방법론에서 답답함을 느끼고 이 대통령에게 의견을 물었다는 것이다.)

President Lee said, "The international community has imposed blockades and sanctions, but in the end, hasn't it come to this?" He added, "North Korea appears to realistically possess around 50 to 60 nuclear weapons, continues to produce nuclear material capable of making 10 to 20 warheads per year, and is nearly at the final stage of ICBM reentry technology." (이 대통령은 “국제사회가 봉쇄하고 제재했지만 결국은 지금까지 이러고 오지 않았느냐”며 “북한은 현실적으로 이미 50~60기 정도의 핵무기를 가지고 있는 것 같고, 1년에 10~20개 정도 만들 수 있는 핵물질을 계속 생산하고 있으며, ICBM 재진입 기술의 마지막 단계까지 거의 다 가고 있다”고 했다.)

He particularly emphasized that the effectiveness of international sanctions has diminished due to strengthened North Korea-Russia military cooperation following the Russia-Ukraine war. When President Trump asked, "Even with Russia's difficulties, would they have provided that much help to North Korea?" President Lee responded, "North Korea's economy is small, while Russia's economy is large, so even a small amount of Russian aid greatly benefits North Korea. I hear North Korea's economic growth rate last year was the highest ever." (특히 러시아·우크라이나 전쟁 이후 강력해진 북·러 군사협력으로 국제 제재의 실효성이 떨어진 점을 강조했다. 트럼프 대통령이 ‘러시아도 어려운데 북한에 그렇게 많은 도움을 줬겠느냐’고 묻자, 이 대통령은 “북한 경제는 요만하고 러시아 경제는 이렇게 크기 때문에 러시아가 조금만 도와줘도 북한은 크게 도움이 된다. 작년에 북한의 경제 성장률이 사상 최고였다고 한다”고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "Since sanctions are now almost ineffective, we must acknowledge the reality that we cannot physically prevent it. Rather than merely shouting for unconditional denuclearization, it is time to negotiate over halting additional development of nuclear materials or missiles. The U.S. needs to present a realistic proposal that North Korea can relate to and begin pragmatic negotiations. We should also consider the opinions of U.S. military experts on this." It was reported that President Trump largely agreed with this explanation. (이 대통령은 “이제는 제재가 거의 실효성이 없기 때문에, 현실적으로 물리적으로 막을 수 없는 단계를 인정해야 한다”며 “무조건적인 비핵화만 외치기보다 이제는 핵 물질 추가 개발 또는 미사일 추가 개발을 중단하는 것을 가지고 협상해야 할 때다. 미국이 북한이 공감할 수 있는 현실적인 안을 내고, 현실성 있는 협상을 시작해야 한다는 미국의 군사 전문가들의 의견도 참고할 필요가 있다”고 했다. 트럼프 대통령 역시 이러한 설명에 많은 공감을 표시한 것으로 전해졌다.)

President Lee emphasized, "It would be good if we could resolve the deadlock through pressure, but the harsh reality is that it doesn't work. My view is that politics must be based on reality." (이 대통령은 “교착 상태를 압박을 통해 해결할 수 있으면 좋은데 문제 해결이 안 된다는 게 냉엄한 현실”이라며 “정치는 현실에 기반해야 한다는 게 제 생각”이라고 강조했다.)

He continued, "It's important to make idealistic, value-based elegant arguments, but if you only make arguments and the situation worsens, that is irresponsible. If we're not careful, there are many such cases in our politics too. Making flashy statements without taking responsibility for the results, while gradually worsening the situation—that is a path that should not be taken, whether in international or domestic politics." (이어 “이상적이고 가치에 기반한 우아한 주장을 하는 것도 중요한데, 주장만 하고 상황이 더 나빠진다면 그것은 무책임한 것”이라며 “자칫 잘못하면 우리 정치에도 그런 일이 많은 것 같다. 결과에 책임도 못 지면서 말은 멋있게 하는데 상황을 점점 나쁘게 만드는 것은 국제 정치든 국내 정치든 가서는 안 될 길”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Requested Pope to Visit North Korea... Pope Also Responded Positively" (李대통령 “교황에 방북 요청...교황도 적극 추진 화답”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Requested Pope to Visit North Korea... Pope Also Responded Positively" (李대통령 “교황에 방북 요청...교황도 적극 추진 화답”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 19th during a Blue House briefing on his European tour, "I met with Pope Leo XIV and requested that he also promote a visit to North Korea next year," adding, "The Pope said he would actively consider and pursue it." (이재명 대통령은 19일 유럽 순방 관련 청와대 브리핑에서 “레오 14세 교황을 만나 내년에 북한 방문도 추진해 주시도록 요청드렸다”며 “교황께서도 적극적으로 고려하고 추진해보겠다는 말씀을 하셨다”고 말했다.)

President Lee officially visited the Vatican on the 15th (local time) and met with the Pope at the Holy See. The Pope is scheduled to visit South Korea next August to attend the World Youth Day in Seoul. President Lee requested that during his visit, the Pope, along with visiting the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), also visit North Korea if possible. (이 대통령은 지난 15일(현지 시각) 바티칸을 공식 방문해 교황청에서 교황을 만났다. 교황은 내년 8월 서울에서 열리는 세계청년대회 참석차 방한할 예정인데, 이 대통령은 교황의 방한 때 비무장지대(DMZ) 방문과 함께 가급적 북한도 방문해달라고 요청했다는 것이다.)

President Lee also mentioned that during his meeting with the Pope, he noted the lack of a cardinal overseeing domestic dioceses and requested the appointment of a cardinal. <<>> (이 대통령은 교황을 만나 국내 교구 업무를 담당하는 추기경이 한 명도 없다는 점을 언급하며 추기경 임명도 요청했다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Lee on controversy over Jung Cheong-rae's 'send-off snub'... "Having people line up for protocols isn't something I'm thrilled about" (李, 정청래 ‘배웅 패싱’ 논란에... “줄 서서 의전, 흔쾌하지 않아”)
item.description:
Lee on controversy over Jung Cheong-rae's 'send-off snub'... "Having people line up for protocols isn't something I'm thrilled about" (李, 정청래 ‘배웅 패싱’ 논란에... “줄 서서 의전, 흔쾌하지 않아”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated during a briefing upon returning from his overseas trip on the 19th that the recent allegations of conflict with the Democratic Party leadership raised in some political circles are "part of the process for doing better." In particular, regarding the controversy over a 'send-off snub' that erupted after party leader Jung Cheong-rae did not appear at the airport send-off event for the overseas trip, he shared his personal thoughts on airport protocol practices and urged against overinterpretation. <<> When asked about the various interpretations sparked by the party leadership not showing up at the departure gate, President Lee replied, "Frankly, when I go abroad or return, having a lot of people line up for that isn't something I find particularly pleasant or enjoyable." He added, "It's just part of routine work, and I wondered if it's really necessary to do that." <<> He continued, "This time, when we were leaving, I had the thought that it wasn't absolutely necessary to do that. Anyway, it seems that some people were unable to or chose not to attend." This suggests he naturally accepted the absence of Representative Jung and others, consistent with his usual belief in scaling back official protocols. <<> Regarding the party-government conflict, he said, "The original purpose and reason for existence of a political party is to gain the people's choice through elections and seize power." He added, "In our democratic society, the people periodically make such choices at set intervals, so we must constantly strive to earn the people's selection." In particular, he stated, "Theorists, idealists, thinkers, and activists only need to make good arguments, and even if others don't agree, that has its own value. But in politics, the ultimate conclusion is gathering many sympathizers and people who agree. Therefore, politics must always be inclusive." <<> President Lee explained, "Gathering only those who actively agree and sympathize with the fundamental direction makes it difficult to represent the entire political landscape." He added, "While we shouldn't lose our original ideals and values, we can't force them on others. Just as you gain more friends by continuously striving to draw sympathy from as many people as possible and finding common points even when there are slight differences, politics works the same way." <<> Regarding the party-government relationship, President Lee stated, "In that sense, they are both the same entity and separate entities. Since the government is created by the party, they naturally need to cooperate. The government expects support and backing from the party, and the government's state affairs achievements ultimately belong to the party and are evaluated by the people." On the recent conflict dynamics, he remarked, "To you watching, it may look like a massive conflict, but I see it as part of the process for doing better." <<> President Lee emphasized, "When you're a minority opposition party, you have to rally your supporters as much as possible to survive. There's no time for inclusiveness. But once you become the ruling party, your stance changes." <<> Regarding the appointment of conservative figures and others, he said, "I've heard some say, 'Why are you not using our people and always using others'? That our side feels quite disappointed. But from an objective view, we haven't not used our own people." (이재명 대통령은 19일 순방 귀국 브리핑에서 최근 정치권 일각에서 제기된 더불어민주당 지도부와의 갈등설에 대해 “더 잘되기 위한 과정”이라고 했다. 특히 정청래 당대표가 순방 출국 행사에 모습을 보이지 않아 불거진 ‘배웅 패싱’ 논란에 대해서는 공항 의전 관행에 대한 개인적 소회를 밝히며 확대해석을 경계해 달라고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Election Commission Fact-Finding Committee Recommends Investigation of Roh Tae-ak and Wi Cheol-hwan ([속보] 선관위 진상규명위, 노태악·위철환 수사 의뢰 권고)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Election Commission Fact-Finding Committee Recommends Investigation of Roh Tae-ak and Wi Cheol-hwan ([속보] 선관위 진상규명위, 노태악·위철환 수사 의뢰 권고)

The Central Election Commission’s Fact-Finding Committee on the Ballot Paper Shortage announced on the 19th that it recommended the Central Election Commission request an investigation into 12 individuals, including former Central Election Commission Chair Roh Tae-ak and Acting Central Election Commission Chair Wi Cheol-hwan. (중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족사태 진상규명위원회는 19일 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장과 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행 등 12명에 대해 중앙선관위에 수사 의뢰를 권고했다고 밝혔다.)

Fact-Finding Committee Chair Cho Hyun-uk made this announcement during a briefing on the committee’s activities held at the Central Election Commission in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province. (조현욱 진상규명위원장은 이날 경기 과천 중앙선관위에서 활동 보고 브리핑을 열고 이같이 밝혔다.)

The individuals targeted for the recommended investigation by the Fact-Finding Committee include former Chair Roh, Acting Chair Wi, the Secretary-General, Deputy Secretary-General, and Director of the Election Policy Office of the Central Election Commission; the Chair, Standing Commissioner, Director of the Secretariat, and Election Section Head of the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission; and the Chair, Director of the Secretariat, and Election Officer of the Songpa District Election Commission—a total of 12 people. (진상규명위의 수사 의뢰 권고 대상은 노 전 위원장과 위 대행, 중앙선관위 사무총장·사무차장·선거정책실장, 서울시선관위 위원장·상임위원·사무처장·선거과장, 송파구선관위 위원장·사무국장·선거담당관 등 12명이다.)

The Fact-Finding Committee also announced that it recommended disciplinary action against six staff members from the Central Election Commission, the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission, and the Songpa District Election Commission who were involved in the incident. (진상규명위는 또 중앙선관위, 서울시선관위, 송파구선관위 직원들 중 이번 사태에 관련 있는 실무자 총 6명을 징계 권고했다고도 발표했다.)

Chair Cho stated, “Given the comprehensive systemic failure of the election management system, a sweeping overhaul close to dismantling the Election Commission is necessary.” As measures to prevent recurrence, he proposed introducing a full-time system for the Central Election Commission Chair, improving the system to include the Election Commission within the scope of the Board of Audit and Inspection’s duty inspections, raising the ballot paper printing ratio to 70% or more, reducing the scope of authority for final approval by the Central Election Commission Secretariat, and establishing a real-time monitoring system to track voter turnout by polling station. (조 위원장은 “선거관리시스템의 총제적 부실 상황을 볼 때, 선거관리위원회의 해체에 가까운 대대적 혁신이 필요하다”며 재발방지를 위한 대책으로 중앙선관위원장 상근제 도입, 감사원의 직무감찰 범위에 선관위를 포함하도록 제도 개선, 투표용지 인쇄 비율 70% 이상으로 상향, 중앙선관위 사무처 전결 범위 축소, 투표소별 투표율 현황 파악을 위한 실시간 모니터링 시스템 구축 등을 제시했다.)

The Fact-Finding Committee, composed of six external experts, operated for ten days from the 10th to the 19th. Chair Cho stated, “We strove to investigate and verify this incident with the eyes and hearts of the people, from an objective and neutral position, independent of progressive or conservative camp logic.” (진상규명위는 선관위 외부 인사 6명으로 구성돼 지난 10일부터 이날까지 열흘 동안 활동했다. 조 위원장은 “진보, 보수 진영 논리와 무관하게 객관적이고 중립적인 위치에서 국민의 눈과 마음으로 이 사건을 조사, 확인하려고 노력했다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Approval Ratings Plummet Since Election Day... Ultimately, Unlimited Responsibility" (李대통령 “선거일 기점 지지율 폭락…결론적 무한 책임”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Approval Ratings Plummet Since Election Day... Ultimately, Unlimited Responsibility" (李대통령 “선거일 기점 지지율 폭락…결론적 무한 책임”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated, "Approval ratings have been plummeting since election day," and emphasized, "This must be taken seriously." (이재명 대통령이 “선거일을 기점으로 지지율이 폭락하고 있다”며 “엄중하게 받아들여야 한다”고 말했다.)

During a briefing on the results of his tour to Europe and the G7 (Group of Seven) summit held at the Cheongwadae Spring and Autumn Hall on the 19th, President Lee said, "If we divide the period before and after the (June 3) local elections, I haven't changed, and state affairs haven't changed. We are continuously making efforts, and there have been small but meaningful achievements." He added, "However, (the drop in approval ratings) is a stark reality. Ultimately, I must bear unlimited responsibility. I must strive to remove the causes." (이 대통령은 19일 청와대 춘추관에서 열린 유럽·G7(주요 7국) 정상회의 순방 결과 브리핑에서 “(6·3) 지방선거를 기점으로 전후를 나눠 본다면 저는 변한 게 없고, 국정은 변한 게 없다. 끊임없이 노력하고 있고, 작으나마 성과들이 있다”면서도 “(지지율 하락은) 냉정한 현실이다. 결론적으로 무한 책임을 져야 한다. 원인을 제거하기 위해 애써야 한다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the background of the declining approval ratings, President Lee remarked, "People are struggling to make a living, and they must be thinking, 'Why are you fighting over things? What do your squabbles have to do with our lives?' From the public's perspective, this is a situation where they have every right to be angry." He added, "We need to make efforts to resolve this situation as quickly as possible." (이 대통령은 지지율 하락의 배경으로 “먹고살기 힘들어 죽겠는데 뭘 가지고 싸우는 것이냐, 여러분의 다툼이 우리의 삶과 무슨 상관이 있느냐고 국민들은 생각할 것”이라며 “국민들 입장에서는 충분히 화가 날 만한 상황”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “최대한 빨리 이 상황을 정리할 수 있도록 노력해야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

On the internal party power struggle within the Democratic Party, he said, "I have one thing I must say about the competition and conflict within the Democratic Party. Do not fight as if you are mortal enemies." He continued, "Are you going to wage war instead of competing within the same fence of the same faction?" He added, "They insult, slander, fabricate non-existent facts to attack, and so on." (민주당 내부의 당권 경쟁과 관련해서는 “민주당 내의 경쟁과 갈등에 대해 한마디 꼭 드리고 싶다. 원수 싸우듯이 하지 마시라”고 했다. 이어 “같은 진영이라고 하는 울타리 안에 있는 사람들끼리 경쟁을 하는 게 아니라 전쟁을 해야 되겠냐”면서 “모욕하고 헐뜯고, 없는 사실을 만들어 공격하고 그런다”고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "Competition and debate should be based on facts. Do not fabricate things that don't exist. You may think it's just a technique, but it's a bad thing. The damage cannot be repaired between each other." (이 대통령은 “있는 사실에 기초해서 경쟁하고 논쟁해야 한다. 없는 것 지어내지 말라”면서 “이것도 하나의 테크닉이라고 생각하는지 모르지만 그것은 나쁜 짓이다. 다시 서로 회복할 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Need for monitoring and control of the National Election Commission... Even a one-point constitutional amendment should be pursued" (李대통령 “선관위 감시·통제 필요...원포인트 개헌이라도 해야")
item.description:
President Lee: "Need for monitoring and control of the National Election Commission... Even a one-point constitutional amendment should be pursued" (李대통령 “선관위 감시·통제 필요...원포인트 개헌이라도 해야")

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 19th regarding the 'ballot paper shortage incident' that occurred during the June 3 local elections, "There is a serious problem and we must respond," adding, "If there is consensus between the ruling and opposition parties, shouldn't we consider even a one-point constitutional amendment concerning the National Election Commission?" (이재명 대통령은 19일 6·3 지방선거에서 일어난 ‘투표 용지 부족 사태’에 대해 “심각한 문제가 있고 대응을 해야 된다”며 “여야 간에 의견 일치가 된다면 선관위에 관한 원포인트 개헌이라도 해야 하지 않을까”라고 말했다.)

He argued that the incident resulted from insufficient checks, controls, and oversight of the National Election Commission, and because the commission is an independent body under the Constitution, creating a legal oversight system could be unconstitutional, hence the need for a constitutional amendment. (이번 일이 선관위에 대한 견제와 통제, 감시가 부족해서 벌어진 것인데, 헌법상 선관위가 독립 기관이어서 법률로 감시 체계를 만들면 위헌 소지가 있으니 개헌이 필요하다는 것이다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a Cheong Wa Dae briefing explaining the outcomes of his overseas trip, when a related question was raised. He said, "There was no authority for any control, monitoring, or checks (on the National Election Commission)." Regarding the commission, he added, "As a neutral institution stipulated by the Constitution to maintain the so-called fundamental democratic order through the voting system, if it is subject to no controls, it must bear that much responsibility. But instead of taking responsibility, it acted freely." Lee also said, "It is unimaginable that there was a shortage of ballots," and "It seems they enjoyed freedom akin to broadcasting." <<> Regarding the younger generation in their 20s and 30s who have been voicing criticism over the ballot paper shortage, President Lee said, "Actually, I was a bit surprised; I thought they were better than our older generation." He added, "I had a preconception that young people were very self-centered and indifferent to the world's justice, fairness, and order, but they raised issues in areas where we were either indifferent or gave less attention. I thought, 'Ah, they are different from our generation,' and I am very grateful for that." (이 대통령은 이날 순방 성과를 설명하는 청와대 브리핑에서 관련 질문이 나오자 “(선관위에 대한) 아무런 통제나 감시, 견제의 권한이 없었다”며 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 선관위에 대해 “국가의 가장 근간인 소위 민주적 기본 질서를 유지하는 투표 제도를, 헌법이 정한 중립 기관으로서 아무 통제도 받지 않으면 그만큼 책임을 져야 되는데 책임을 진 게 아니라 자유롭게 해버렸다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “투표지가 부족하게 만든 건 상상할 수 없는 일”이라며 “방송에 가까운 자유를 구가했던 것 같다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Han Dong-hoon to Publish Memoir on '20-Year Lone Star Battle' ([단독]한동훈 ‘20년 론스타 투쟁史’ 회고록 출간한다)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Han Dong-hoon to Publish Memoir on '20-Year Lone Star Battle' ([단독]한동훈 ‘20년 론스타 투쟁史’ 회고록 출간한다)

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon (first-term, Buk-gu, Busan) has been confirmed on the 19th to publish a memoir next month detailing the full story behind the cancellation of the international investment dispute ruling with U.S. private equity fund Lone Star. This marks his second book, following the release of 'The People Come First,' which documented the December 3 martial law situation. (무소속 한동훈(초선·부산 북갑) 의원이 내달 초 미국계 사모펀드 론스타와의 국제 투자분쟁 판정 취소 사건의 전말과 관련한 회고록을 출간할 것으로 19일 확인됐다. 12·3 비상계엄 상황을 기록한 ‘국민이 먼저입니다’를 출간한 데 이어 두 번째 저서다.)

According to political circles, the upcoming Lone Star memoir compiles records from over 20 years—starting from Han's time as a prosecutor investigating the 2006 Lone Star stock manipulation case, through his tenure as Minister of Justice when he filed an application for annulment with the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID), to the eventual victory in November last year. The Lone Star international investment dispute, which began in November 2012, continued for 13 years until the South Korean government won in November 2025. Legal experts have praised this as "the government safeguarding 7 trillion won in national wealth" with the victory. (정치권에 따르면 이번에 출간되는 론스타 회고록은 한 의원이 검사 시절 2006년 론스타 주가조작 사건을 수사할 때부터 법무부 장관으로서 국제투자분쟁해결센터(ICSID)에 판정취소 신청하고, 지난해 11월 결국 승소하기까지 20년간 기록들을 정리한 것이다. 2012년 11월부터 시작된 론스타 국제 투자분쟁은 2025년 11월 우리 정부가 승소할 때까지 13년간 진행됐다. 법조계에선 “이번 승소로 우리 정부가 7조원의 국부(國富)를 지켰다”고 평가하고 있다.)

Han reportedly began writing the Lone Star memoir early this year, around the time he was expelled from the People Power Party. The publication was temporarily halted when he decided to run in the April by-election for Buk-gu, Busan, but he resumed finalizing the work after the election. (한 의원은 국민의힘에서 제명될 당시인 올해 초부터 론스타 회고록 집필에 들어간 것으로 알려졌다. 이후 지난 4월 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 출마를 결심하면서 출간은 잠시 중단했다가, 선거가 끝난 이후 마무리 작업에 돌입했다고 한다.)

As a prosecutor in 2006, Han handled the Korea Exchange Card stock manipulation case and, after a decade-long legal battle, secured a final guilty verdict from the Supreme Court. In 2022, while serving as Minister of Justice, he initiated a lawsuit to overturn the decision ordering the South Korean government to compensate Lone Star 280 billion won, refusing to accept the ruling. (한 의원은 검사 시절이던 2006년 외환카드 주가 조작 사건을 맡아 10년에 걸친 소송 끝에 대법원에서 유죄 확정 판결을 받아냈다. 2022년 법무장관 재직 시 한국 정부가 론스타에 2800억원을 배상하라는 결정이 내려지자 이에 불복해 취소 소송에 나섰다.)

The South Korean government's victory over Lone Star at the ICSID is extremely rare worldwide. In fact, out of 503 annulment applications filed since ICSID's inception in 1966 up to June this year, only 25 cases (5%) have been fully or partially granted. For this reason, when then-Minister of Justice Han Dong-hoon filed the annulment lawsuit in 2023, figures from the Democratic Party of Korea uniformly criticized it, saying, "The chances of winning are zero." (우리 정부가 국제투자분쟁해결센터(ICSID)에서 론스타에 승소한 것은 세계적으로도 매우 드문 일이다. 실제 1966년 ICSID 출범 이후 올해 6월까지 취소 신청된 사건 503건 가운데 전부 또는 일부 인용된 사건 25건(5%)에 불과하다. 이 때문에 2023년 당시 한동훈 법무부 장관이 취소 소송을 제기하자 더불어민주당 인사들은 일제히 “이길 가능성은 제로”라고 비판했었다.)

Song Ki-ho, current economic security secretary at the presidential office, said at the time, "The possibility of a ruling concluding that the South Korean government has no liability for compensation in the ICSID annulment process is zero," adding, "Minister Han's explanation is misleading the public." Park Yong-jin, then a Democratic Party incumbent lawmaker and now deputy chairman of the Presidential Regulatory Reform Committee, also remarked, "The Ministry of Justice spent over 40 billion won on law firms for the ISDS lawsuit," calling it "an administrative act that only fattened law firms." Pro-government YouTuber Kim Eo-jun also targeted then-Minister Han, saying, "Does he think he's some international crown prince? He's talking nonsense," and added, "Since he said he could win, shouldn't Minister Han take responsibility for the outcome?" (송기호 현 청와대 경제안보비서관은 당시 “ICSID 취소 절차에서 한국 정부에 배상 책임이 없다는 법적 결론이 판정으로 나올 가능성은 ‘제로(0)’”라며 “한동훈 장관의 설명은 국민을 착각하게 만드는 것”이라고 했다. 당시 민주당 현역 의원이던 박용진 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장도 “법무부가 ISDS 소송으로 400억원이 넘는 돈을 로펌에 썼다”며 “로펌만 배 불린 행정 행위”라고 했다. 친여(親與)유튜버 김어준씨도 당시 한동훈 법무장관을 겨냥해 “자기가 국제적으로 황태자인 줄 아나, 말도 안 되는 소리를 하지”라며 “자기가 이길 수 있다고 한 것이니 (소송 결과에 대해)한 장관이 책임져야 되는 거 아니냐”고 했었다.)

However, when the South Korean government won in November last year, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said in an emergency briefing, "This is a remarkable achievement by the new government in the foreign sector." Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho, who attended the briefing, also stated, "In the absence of the (impeached) president and justice minister following the December 3 insurrection last year, officials including the director of the Ministry's International Legal Affairs Bureau gave their all." (그러나 지난해 11월 우리 정부가 승소하자 김민석 국무총리는 긴급브리핑에서 “새 정부가 대외부문에서 거둔 쾌거”라고 했다. 브리핑에 배석한 정성호 법무부 장관도 “지난해 12·3 내란 이후 (탄핵 소추된) 대통령과 법무장관이 부재한 상황에서 법무부 국제법무국장 등 직원들이 혼신의 힘을 다했다”고 했다.)

Han's 'Lone Star Memoir' is expected to include reflections on the Democratic Party's behavior. In an interview with this newspaper last November, Han said, "I devoted 10 years of my prosecutor career to the Lone Star case," adding, "Because I knew it better than anyone, I believed there was a chance of winning even upon appeal." (한 의원의 ‘론스타 회고록’에는 이 같은 민주당 행태에 대한 소회도 담길 예정이다. 한 의원은 지난해 11월 본지 인터뷰에서 “론스타 사건은 내 검사 인생 10년을 바쳤다”며 “누구보다 잘 알기 때문에 항소해도 승산이 있다고 봤다”고 했다.)

He added, "At the time, the Democratic Party obstructed the appeal with all sorts of attacks, saying things like, 'Why bother with a lawsuit you're going to lose anyway?' 'With interest costs piling up daily, will the minister take responsibility for breach of trust?' and 'He's just doing pointless things to make a name for himself,'" and noted, "The person who obstructed the most back then is now the economic security secretary at the presidential office." (그러면서 “당시 민주당은 ‘어차피 질 소송을 뭐하러 하느냐’ ‘이자 비용이 날마다 불어나는데 장관이 배임죄로 책임질 거냐’ ‘자기 이름 날리려고 쓸데없는 짓 한다’ 등 온갖 공격으로 항소를 방해했다”며 “그때 가장 방해했던 사람이 지금 청와대 경제안보비서관”이라고 했다.)

item.title: "Oh Se-hoon Expanding His Stride into 'Yeouido Politics' with 'Opposition Landscape Restructuring'" (“야권 지형 재편” ‘여의도 정치’로 보폭 넓히는 오세훈)
item.description:
"Oh Se-hoon Expanding His Stride into 'Yeouido Politics' with 'Opposition Landscape Restructuring'" (“야권 지형 재편” ‘여의도 정치’로 보폭 넓히는 오세훈)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon is set to appear as a lecturer at the 'Future Innovation Forum,' a National Assembly research group primarily composed of former pro-Yoon factions within the People Power Party. Separately, he has also confirmed a meeting schedule with People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik, broadening his sphere of activity into 'Yeouido political circles.' Within and outside the party, interpretations suggest that "Mayor Oh is moving in step with the 2030 'presidential election clock.'" (오세훈 서울시장이 국민의힘 옛 친윤계가 주축인 국회 연구 모임 ‘미래혁신포럼’에 강연자로 나선다. 이와 별개로 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표와의 회동 일정도 확정하면서 ‘여의도 정치권’으로 활동 반경도 넓혀 나가고 있다. 당 안팎에선 “오 시장이 2030년 ‘대선 시계’에 발맞춰서 움직이고 있는 것”이란 해석이 나온다.)

According to the People Power Party, Mayor Oh is scheduled to give a lecture on the 24th at the National Assembly Members' Office Building, under the theme of 'The Direction Korean Politics Should Take.' A party official stated, "Under the topic of the conservative party's responsibilities and future, we understand that Mayor Oh will also reveal his vision for changes in the party's course." In an interview with this newspaper on the 8th, following his victory in the June 3 by-election, Mayor Oh said, "The People Power Party now stands at a crossroads: whether to advance into the rough seas of the center, or to degenerate into a 'YouTube party' that only scratches where the hardline supporters itch." (국민의힘에 따르면, 오 시장은 24일 국회 의원회관에서 ‘대한민국 정치의 나아가야 할 방향’이라는 취지로 강연할 예정이다. 국민의힘 측은 “보수당의 책임과 미래라는 주제로, 당 노선 변화에 대한 오 시장의 구상도 밝힐 것으로 안다”고 했다. 오 시장은 6·3 지방선거에서 승리한 이후인 지난 8일 본지 인터뷰에서 “지금 국민의힘은 중도의 거친 바다로 나아가느냐, 아니면 강성 지지층의 가려운 곳만 긁어주는 ‘유튜브 정당’으로 전락하느냐 기로에 섰다”고 했다.)

The lecture is hosted by the National Assembly research group, the Future Innovation Forum. The forum is chaired by People Power Party lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun (5th term, Nam-gu, Ulsan) and involves about 30 People Power Party lawmakers classified as former pro-Yoon figures. Recently, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon (first term, Buk-gu, Busan) joined the forum, sparking interest. On the day of the lecture, attention is also focused on whether Mayor Oh, a leading conservative presidential candidate, and lawmaker Han will meet at the same event. (강연회는 국회 연구 모임 미래혁신포럼이 주최했다. 미래혁신포럼은 국민의힘 김기현(5선·울산 남을) 의원이 회장으로, 옛 친윤계로 분류되는 국민의힘 의원 30여 명이 활동하고 있다. 최근에는 무소속 한동훈(초선·부산 북갑) 의원이 미래혁신포럼에 가입하면서 화제가 되기도 했다. 강연 당일 보수 진영 차기 대선 주자인 오 시장과 한 의원이 한자리에서 조우할지도 주목된다.)

Since the election, Mayor Oh has continued meetings with People Power Party lawmakers. On the 14th, he held a lunch meeting with former Saenuri Party leader Kim Moo-sung, lawmaker Na Kyung-won, and former lawmakers Kim Sung-tae, Kim Young-joo, and Choi Jae-hyung, who served as advisors for the Seoul election campaign committee. A dinner gathering with People Power Party lawmakers from the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee and Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee is also scheduled for the end of this month. Next month, he plans to meet privately with floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik. (오 시장은 선거 이후 국민의힘 의원들과의 만남도 이어가고 있다. 지난 14일에는 서울시 선거대책위원회 고문을 맡았던 김무성 전 새누리당 대표·나경원 의원·김성태·김영주·최재형 전 의원과 오찬 회동을 가졌고, 이달 말까지 국회 행정안전위원회·국토교통위원회 소속 국민의힘 의원들과의 만찬 일정도 예정되어 있다. 내달에는 정점식 원내대표와도 비공개로 만나기로 했다.)

Within the People Power Party, lawmakers such as Kwon Young-jin, Cho Eun-hee, Kim Jae-seop, and Park Soo-min are considered close to Mayor Oh. Regarding Mayor Oh's recent active moves, political circles interpret them as "aiming to secure allies within the party with an eye on the upcoming presidential election." A People Power Party lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area remarked, "Won't the opposition landscape naturally be restructured around presidential contenders Oh Se-hoon and Han Dong-hoon going forward?" (현재 국민의힘 내에서는 권영진·조은희·김재섭·박수민 의원 등이 오 시장과 가깝다는 평가다. 최근 오 시장의 적극적인 행보를 두고 정치권에서는 “다가오는 대선까지 염두에 두고 당내 우군을 확보하려는 것”이라는 해석이 나온다. 수도권의 한 국민의힘 의원은 “향후 야권의 지형도 대선 주자인 오세훈·한동훈을 축으로 자연스럽게 재편되지 않겠느냐”고 말했다.)

item.title: Lee Directs Sharp Criticism at DP Leadership Race... "Don't Fight Like Mortal Enemies" (李, 당권경쟁 민주당 직격... “원수 싸우듯 하지 마라”)
item.description:
Lee Directs Sharp Criticism at DP Leadership Race... "Don't Fight Like Mortal Enemies" (李, 당권경쟁 민주당 직격... “원수 싸우듯 하지 마라”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 19th, "I also want to say a word about the competition and conflict within the Democratic Party of Korea," and added, "Don't fight like mortal enemies." (이재명 대통령은 19일 “더불어민주당 내의 경쟁과 갈등에 대해서도 한 말씀 꼭 드리고 싶다”며 “원수 싸우듯이 하지 마라”고 했다.)

During a briefing at the Cheong Wa Dae Spring and Autumn Pavilion on the outcomes of his European tour and participation in the G7 summit, President Lee stated, "People standing within the same camp, as we call it, shouldn't be waging war instead of competing," making the remarks. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 춘추관에서 열린 유럽 순방과 주요 7국 정상회의 참석 결과 브리핑에서 “같은 진영이라고 하는 울타리 안에 서 있는 사람들끼리 경쟁하는 게 아니라 전쟁해서야 되겠느냐”며 이같이 말했다.)

He said, "Don't insult each other," noting, "There are people who insult, belittle, and even hide to do so. Why is their expression so cheap?" He continued, "This isn't politics; it's gang fighting. How uncomfortable must it be for the public to watch? Once it's over, it's all done. Afterward, we still have to see each other every day." (그는 “(서로를) 모욕하지 말라”며 “모욕하고, 폄하하고, 꼭 숨어가지고 그러는 사람도 있다. 표현은 왜 그리 저렴하며”라고 했다. 이어 “정치를 하는 게 아니라 패싸움을 하고 있다. 그거 국민이 보시기에 얼마나 불편하겠는가”라며 “지나면 다 그만이다. 지나면 또 맨날 보고 살아야 한다”고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "Insulting, slandering, and attacking with fabricated facts—then the other side claims they're unfairly treated. Rational competition must be based on facts. Do not fabricate nonexistent facts." He added, "It's called the 'straw man tactic'—attacking by making up false claims and getting others to think, 'Oh, that might be real.' Some might see it as a technique, but it's a bad thing. It can't be undone, and it's war. There are people who insult, demean, and always hide to do so." (이 대통령은 “모욕하고 헐뜯고, 없는 사실을 만들어 공격하고, 그러니까 (상대방은) 또 억울하다고 그런다”며 “합리적 경쟁을, 있는 사실에 기초해서 해야 한다. 없는 사실을 지어내지 말라”고 했다. 그러면서 “‘허수아비 전법’이라고, 없는 사실을 지어내서 공격하고 다른 사람들이 ‘어, 저거 진짜 있나봐’라고 하는 게 하나의 테크닉이라 생각할지 모르지만, 나쁜 짓”이라며 “다시 회복할 수 없고, 그건 전쟁이다. 서로 모욕하고 폄훼하고, 꼭 숨어서 그런 사람들이 있다”고 했다.)

He also stated, "Whether between ruling and opposition parties or within a party, I hope political debates become competition, not war. That competition should not be a fight to the death or a vulgar, outdated rivalry, but rather a discussion on who does better, who is more rational and efficient, in front of the public." (또한 “여야 간이든 당내든 정치적인 논쟁은 전쟁이 아닌 경쟁이었으면 좋겠다”며 “그 경쟁도 죽이기 경쟁이 아니고 저열한 구태의 경쟁이 아니고 누가 더 잘하나, 누가 더 합리적이고 효율적인가를 국민이 보는 앞에서 논쟁할 수 있으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the declining approval ratings for his administration, President Lee said that day, "Since the election day, approval ratings have plummeted. We must take it seriously." He added, "It's the public's assessment. That's probably the case. It must mean more people are dissatisfied with President Lee Jae-myung," answering in this manner. (이날 이 대통령은 국정 지지율 하락세에 대해서는 “선거일을 기점으로 지지율이 폭락하고 있다. 엄중하게 받아들여야죠”라고 했다. 그러면서 “국민의 평가다. 그런 거겠지. 이재명 대통령 마음에 안 든다는 사람이 늘어난 거 아니겠어요”라며 이같이 답했다.)

item.title: Former Chairman Noh Tae-ak, 'Coming to work once every two days' ahead of elections, received 179.1 million won in allowances over four years (선거 앞두고 ‘이틀에 한 번 출근’ 노태악 전 위원장, 4년간 수당만 1억7910만원)
item.description:
Former Chairman Noh Tae-ak, 'Coming to work once every two days' ahead of elections, received 179.1 million won in allowances over four years (선거 앞두고 ‘이틀에 한 번 출근’ 노태악 전 위원장, 4년간 수당만 1억7910만원)

Former Central Election Commission Chairman Noh Tae-ak, who resigned taking responsibility for the shortage of ballots in the June 3 local elections, has been found to have received 179.1 million won in allowances while working part-time over four years. Regardless of whether he commuted to work, former Chairman Noh received a minimum of 550,000 won to a maximum of 6.15 million won per month. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태의 책임을 지고 사퇴한 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 4년간 비상근으로 일하며 수당 1억7910만원을 받은 것으로 나타났다. 노 전 위원장은 출퇴근 여부와 무관하게 월 최소 55만원에서 최대 615만원을 받았다.)

According to data submitted by the National Election Commission on the 19th to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Min-jeon, former Chairman Noh received a total of 179,103,220 won in various allowances from his appointment in May 2022 up to last month. (19일 중앙선거관리위원회가 국민의힘 김민전 의원실에 제출한 자료에 따르면 노 전 위원장은 2022년 5월 취임한 이후 지난달까지 각종 수당 명목으로 1억7910만3220원을 받았다.)

Broken down by allowance type, he received 97.1 million won in fair election promotion activity expenses, 66.3 million won in agenda review allowances, and 15.7 million won in attendance allowances. The NEC paid former Chairman Noh 2.9 million won per month in fair election promotion activity expenses regardless of his attendance, provided 150,000 won per meeting for attendance at official events including meetings, and paid 100,000 won per agenda item for agenda review allowances during meetings. (수당 항목별로 보면 공명선거추진활동비 9710만원, 안건검토수당 6630만원, 출무수당 1570만원이다. 중앙선관위는 노 전 위원장의 출근 여부와 무관하게 공명선거추진활동비로 매달 290만원씩 지급했고 회의를 포함한 공식 행사 참석의 경우 회당 15만원의 출무수당을, 회의의 경우 안건 1개당 10만원씩 안건검토수당을 지급했다.)

Notably, after the Board of Audit and Inspection pointed out issues with the 2.9 million won monthly fair election promotion activity expenses paid to former Chairman Noh, the NEC employed a tactic of reorganizing the existing allowance system to continue providing the chairman's allowances. (특히 중앙선관위는 노 전 위원장에게 지급하던 매달 290만원의 공명선거추진활동비가 감사원 감사에서 지적을 받자 기존 수당 체계를 개편하는 꼼수로 위원장의 수당을 챙겨주기도 했다.)

In 2022, when former Chairman Noh took office, the NEC paid him 2.9 million won each month under the name of fair election promotion activity expenses without a legal basis. When the BAI pointed out in November of that year that these allowances "lacked a legal basis," the NEC stopped the payments in January 2023. Instead, the NEC amended its 'Regulations on Allowances for NEC Commissioners' through its own resolution, raising the agenda review allowance from the existing 100,000 won to 300,000 won. Consequently, former Chairman Noh received 5.1 million won in June 2023 solely from agenda review allowances. (중앙선관위는 노 전 위원장이 취임하던 2022년에 법적 근거 없이 공명선거추진활동비라는 명목으로 노 전 위원장에게 매달 290만원씩 지급했다. 그해 11월 감사원이 해당 수당에 “법적 근거가 없다”고 지적하자 중앙선관위는 2023년 1월 지급을 중단했다. 대신 중앙선관위 자체 의결로 ‘중앙선관위 위원 수당에 관한 규칙’을 개정해 안건검토수당을 기존 10만원에서 30만원으로 올렸다. 이에 따라 노 전 위원장은 2023년 6월 안건검토수당으로만 510만원을 받기도 했다.)

Later, in January 2024, the National Assembly revised the Election Commission Act to create a legal basis for the fair election promotion activity expenses that the BAI had flagged, and from January 2024 onward, former Chairman Noh again received 2.9 million won per month. From that point, the agenda review allowance was restored from 300,000 won back to the original 100,000 won. (이후 국회가 2024년 1월 선관위법을 개정해 감사원이 지적한 공명선거추진활동비의 법적 근거를 만들었고 노 전 위원장은 다시 2024년 1월부터 매달 290만원씩 받았다. 안건검토수당은 이때부터 다시 30만원에서 기존 10만원으로 원상회복됐다.)

Earlier, former Chairman Noh's attendance record had also been called into question. He received allowances of 4.1 million won in March, 5.15 million won in April, and 4.15 million won in June—months just before the election. It has been reported that former Chairman Noh worked a total of 6 days in March, 12 days in April, and 16 days in May. (앞서 노 전 위원장의 근태가 지적되기도 했다. 노 전 위원장은 선거 직전인 지난 3월 410만원, 4월 515만원, 6월 415만원의 수당을 받았다. 노 전 위원장이 출근한 날짜는 3월 총 6일, 4월 총 12일, 5월 총 16일인 것으로 알려졌다.)

Meanwhile, the NEC's fact-finding committee announced after a meeting that day that it has recommended requesting an investigation by the NEC into 12 individuals, including former NEC Chairman Noh and acting NEC Chairman Wi Cheol-hwan. (한편 중앙선관위 진상규명위원회는 이날 회의 뒤 노 전 중앙선거관리위원장과 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행 등 12명에 대해 중앙선관위에 수사 의뢰를 권고했다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Lee: "Even a one-point constitutional amendment on the election commission is necessary... If needed, the president can propose it." (李 “선관위 원포인트 개헌이라도 해야… 필요하면 대통령이 발의”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 19th regarding the "ballot paper shortage crisis" in the June 3 local elections, "If there is bipartisan agreement, shouldn't we consider even a one-point constitutional amendment concerning the election commission?" (이재명 대통령은 19일 6·3 지방선거 ‘투표 용지 부족 사태’에 대해 “여야 간에 의견 일치가 된다면 선관위에 관한 원포인트 개헌이라도 해야 하지 않을까”라고 밝혔다.)

In a briefing at the Blue House that day, President Lee criticized the election commission, saying, "How can it be acceptable for the Chief Justice to effectively appoint the chairperson of the election commission like that? And there are reports that due to the commission being part-time, they didn't even properly show up on election day—how is that acceptable?" He added, "Shouldn't there be proper monitoring, checks, and controls? I believe there is a need to overhaul the legal framework for this." He further stated, "If necessary, the president can directly propose legislation." The implication is that since the election commission is an independent agency under the constitution, strengthening checks, controls, and oversight over it can only be achieved through constitutional amendment. The Democratic Party is making the same argument. However, the People Power Party maintains that constitutional reform is a matter for later, and currently, a parliamentary investigation and a special counsel probe are necessary. <<> In response, President Lee commented, "We need to observe whether the political circles are seriously trying to resolve this issue or using it as a tool for political attacks. We will decide on the government's position after reviewing the political discussions." <<> President Lee also pointed out the ballot paper shortage, saying, "When making ballot papers, you usually produce as many as the number of people who will vote, even when electing a alumni association president, right? Whatever excuses there may be, this is an unacceptable situation." <<> Regarding the 2030 generation, who have been voicing criticism over this incident, President Lee said, "Young people, whom we had prejudged as very selfish and indifferent to justice, fairness, and order in the world, have instead raised issues in areas we deemed ourselves indifferent or less focused on." He added, "I thought, 'Ah, they are different from our generation,' and for that, I am very grateful." <<> However, he stated, "While we must protect the exercise of sovereign rights to secure legitimate voting rights, I have ordered strict investigations and accountability for acts such as publishing false information, spreading fake news, conducting illegal searches and seizures, and obstructing official duties." This was aimed at the recent rally at Seoul's Jamsil Olympic Park, sparked by the ballot paper shortage. President Lee also said, "We will respond strictly where necessary and ensure protection where it is clearly warranted." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 선관위를 향해 “저런 식으로 대법원장이 사실상 (선관위원장을) 임명하는 것처럼 해서 되겠느냐, 또 비상임으로 해서 선거 날에도 제대로 출근을 안 했다는 이야기가 있던데 그렇게 하면 되겠느냐”라며 “감시와 견제, 통제를 적정하게 해야 하지 않겠느냐. 이를 위한 법 제도 정비가 필요하겠다는 생각”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “필요하면 대통령이 직접 법안을 발의할 수도 있다”고 했다. 선관위가 헌법상 독립기관으로 돼 있기 때문에 개헌을 통해야만 선관위에 대한 견제와 통제, 감시를 강화할 수 있다는 취지다. 민주당도 같은 주장을 하고 있다. 하지만 국민의힘은 개헌은 추후 문제이고 당장 국정조사와 함께 특검을 해야 한다는 입장이다.)

item.title: "Board of Audit and Inspection Should Inspect the National Election Commission... Open Discussion Needed on Whether to Keep Advance Voting" (“감사원, 선관위 감찰해야… 사전투표 존폐는 공론화를”)
item.description:
The Central Election Commission's Fact-Finding Committee, which investigated the shortage of ballots during the June 3 local elections, concluded on the 19th—after nine days of inquiry—that the incident was a "total failure of the election management system." The committee recommended that the NEC refer 12 individuals, including former NEC Chair Noh Tae-ak and Acting Chair Wi Cheol-hwan (a standing commissioner), for investigation. The decision on whether to pursue an investigation is expected to be discussed at a plenary meeting of the NEC next week. The committee also proposed that the NEC undergo a duty inspection by the Board of Audit and Inspection and that the NEC chairmanship, traditionally held part-time by a Supreme Court justice, be converted to a full-time position. Regarding the advance voting system, which has faced neglect from some voters, the committee called for a public forum to debate its continuation or abolition. <<> Fact-Finding Committee Chair Jo Hyeon-uk stated at a briefing that, along with former Chair Noh Tae-ak and former Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hun, who have already stepped down over the ballot shortage, Acting Chair Wi Cheol-hwan, a standing commissioner, should also be referred for investigation. Acting Chair Wi, a classmate of President Lee Jae-myung from the 18th class of the Judicial Research and Training Institute, has served as a standing commissioner since last October. The standing commissioner is the only full-time position among the nine NEC commissioners, tasked with assisting the chair and overseeing the secretariat's affairs. However, the seven non-standing NEC commissioners, excluding former Chair Noh and Acting Chair Wi, were not included in the recommendation for investigation. <<> The fact-finding committee also included Seoul Central District Court Chief Judge Oh Min-seok, who served as chair of the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission, and Min So-young, Senior Presiding Judge of the Seoul Eastern District Court, who chaired the Songpa-gu Election Commission, in its recommendations for referral and disciplinary action. An NEC official stated that regarding the committee's recommendations for investigation and disciplinary measures, "If reported to the plenary meeting scheduled for next week, the commissioners will discuss them." <<> Ahead of this local election, the NEC sent guidelines to local election commissions last December, reducing the minimum print run of ballots from 60% of eligible voters to 50%. At least 91 polling stations experienced ballot shortages, and 26 stations ran out of ballots entirely, halting voting. The fact-finding committee described this as "undermining the people's constitutional right to vote through an extremely administrative convenience-oriented mindset" and recommended raising the minimum print run to 70%. Former Chair Noh Tae-ak reportedly told the committee that he had not been briefed on the "50% guideline" beforehand, but later changed his stance, stating that it "was included in the agenda but not specifically discussed, and I did not receive any in-person briefing on the details." <<> Regarding the chaos at polling stations and election commissions, the fact-finding committee noted that "the rapid reporting system completely failed to function, and the higher-level election commissions' command authority was never exercised." The Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission received inquiries from the Songpa-gu Election Commission on election day, June 3, but only realized the severity at 4:46 p.m. and failed to report it to the NEC. Even when voting hours were extended until 10 p.m. at some polling stations in Songpa-gu, Seoul, no report was made to the NEC. Additionally, the Songpa-gu Election Commission began vote counting while voting was still ongoing at the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong. <<> To prevent a recurrence of election management failures, the fact-finding committee argued that the NEC should be included within the scope of the Board of Audit and Inspection's duty inspections. The NEC has previously avoided such inspections by claiming its status as a "constitutional institution." When the Board of Audit and Inspection attempted to conduct a duty inspection during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, the NEC filed a jurisdictional dispute with the Constitutional Court, which ruled in the NEC's favor on the 2nd of last year. Some within the ruling party argue that a constitutional amendment is needed to enable such inspections. <<> The fact-finding committee called for amending the Election Commission Act to make the NEC chair a full-time position. Currently, the NEC chair is elected by the commissioners from among themselves, with a Supreme Court justice serving part-time in the role. The committee stated that "most policy decisions are approved by the secretary-general and others, with only post-hoc reports being made" and argued that "the scope of committee resolutions should be expanded." <<> The fact-finding committee recommended holding a public forum to discuss whether to maintain or abolish the advance voting system. The People Power Party has proposed a bill to eliminate advance voting and extend regular voting to two days, while the Democratic Party of Korea has stated that it has yet to discuss the matter. However, the committee did not offer an opinion on calls for a re-election. Fact-Finding Committee Chair Jo Hyeon-uk said, "It is reasonable to defer to the court's judgment." <<> Meanwhile, it was confirmed that former Chair Noh Tae-ak received a total of 179.1 million won in allowances during his four-year part-time tenure. According to data submitted by the NEC to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Min-jeon, the NEC paid former Chair Noh 179.1 million won in various allowances from his appointment in May 2022 through last month. This included a monthly public election promotion allowance of 2.9 million won, paid regardless of attendance, a 150,000 won meeting attendance fee for attending meetings or official events, and a 100,000 won agenda review fee per agenda item. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사해 온 중앙선거관리위원회 진상규명위원회는 19일 9일간의 조사를 마치고 이번 사태를 “선거관리 시스템의 총체적 부실”로 결론 내렸다. 진상규명위는 선관위에 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장, 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행(상임위원) 등 12명을 수사 의뢰하라고 권고했다. 수사 의뢰 여부는 다음 주 중앙선관위원 전체 회의에서 논의될 전망이다. 진상규명위는 또 선관위가 감사원의 직무 감찰을 받게 하고, 대법관이 비상근으로 맡아온 중앙선관위원장을 상근제로 바꾸자고 했다. 일부 유권자에게 외면받고 있는 사전투표 제도에 대해선 존폐를 논의할 공론의 장이 필요하다고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Trump said he's frustrated with US-North Korea dialogue... I advised a step-by-step approach." (李 “트럼프, 미북 대화 답답하다고 해… 단계적 접근 조언했다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung recently attended the G7 summit in Evian, France, where he encountered U.S. President Donald Trump several times and had a lengthy conversation at the dinner. A significant portion of their discussion reportedly focused on the North Korean nuclear issue. During a briefing upon returning from his overseas trip on the 19th, President Lee detailed the exchange that occurred. The remarks indicate that President Trump's focus has shifted from the Iran nuclear issue to North Korea's nuclear program. (이재명 대통령은 최근 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 G7 정상회의에 참석해 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령을 여러 번 마주쳤고 만찬장에서는 긴 대화를 나눴다. 두 정상 대화의 상당 부분은 ‘북핵’ 문제에 집중됐다고 한다. 이 대통령은 19일 순방 귀국 브리핑에서 그때 오간 대화 내용을 구체적으로 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령의 관심사가 이란 핵에 이어 북핵으로 넘어가고 있음을 보여주는 내용들이다.)

President Trump reportedly told President Lee, "It's time to pay attention to the North Korean issue." He then expressed frustration over ways to resume North Korea-U.S. talks and sought advice from President Lee. (트럼프 대통령은 이 대통령에게 “북한 문제에 대해서도 관심을 가져야 할 때가 됐다”고 했다고 한다. 그러면서 북미 대화 재개 방안에 답답함을 토로하며 이 대통령에게 조언을 구했다는 것이다.)

The two leaders, in particular, sat side by side at the official G7 dinner and conversed for 90 minutes. President Lee stated, "President Trump had the idea that he needed to talk to Kim Jong-un. But as for how to specifically resume dialogue, he seemed frustrated." President Trump also reportedly said, "It's regrettable that North Korea couldn't take feasible measures before realistically possessing nuclear weapons." (두 정상은 특히 G7 공식 만찬장에서 나란히 앉아 90분간 대화를 나눴다. 이 대통령은 “트럼프 대통령은 김정은과 대화해야 되겠다는 생각을 갖고 있었다”며 “그럼 어떻게 구체적으로, (대화를 재개할지) 이 점에 대해서는 답답해했다”고 전했다. 트럼프 대통령은 “북한도 핵무기를 현실적으로 보유하기 전 단계에서 뭔가 가능한 조치를 했어야 하는데 못 해서 아쉽다”는 말도 했다고 한다.)

In response, President Lee said, "'I told him, 'We shouldn't approach the North Korean nuclear issue the same way we deal with other countries,' and he agreed." When President Trump asked, "What exactly should be done?" President Lee replied, "The U.S. is seen as the only counterpart North Korea can talk to, and it would be good if the U.S. could offer a realistic proposal that North Korea can relate to." (이에 이 대통령은 “‘지금은 다른 나라를 대하는 방식으로 북핵 문제를 접근하면 안 된다’고 했고 (트럼프 대통령) 본인도 동의했다”고 전했다. 트럼프 대통령이 “구체적으로 어떻게 해야 되냐”고 묻자 이 대통령은 “미국과 북한이 대화할 수 있는 유일한 상대라고 보여지고, 미국이 좀 북한이 공감할 수 있는 현실적인 안을 좀 내면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee reportedly emphasized that the effectiveness of international sanctions has diminished due to the strengthened military cooperation between North Korea and Russia following the Russia-Ukraine war. When President Trump asked, "Would Russia really have provided that much help to North Korea while it's struggling?" President Lee responded, "North Korea's economy is this small, while Russia's economy is that large, so even a little help from Russia makes a big difference to North Korea. I heard North Korea's economic growth rate last year hit an all-time high." (이 대통령은 러시아·우크라이나 전쟁 이후 강력해진 북·러 군사 협력으로 국제 제재의 실효성이 떨어진 점을 강조했다고 한다. 트럼프 대통령이 ‘러시아도 어려운데 북한에 그렇게 많은 도움을 줬겠느냐’고 묻자, 이 대통령은 “북한 경제는 요만하고 러시아 경제는 이렇게 크기 때문에 러시아가 조금만 도와줘도 북한은 크게 도움이 된다. 작년에 북한의 경제성장률이 사상 최고였다고 한다”고 답했다는 것이다.)

President Lee also explained at length, "North Korea continues to produce nuclear materials, and its ICBM development appears to be in its final stages. Let's set a short-term goal of halting this, and create a situation where there is no longer a threat to the regime, making denuclearization a long-term goal." In response, President Trump reportedly said, "I'll give it enough thought." (이 대통령은 또 “북한은 핵물질을 계속 생산해 내고 있고 ICBM 대륙간탄도미사일도 마지막 개발 단계에 있는 것으로 보인다”며 “이를 중단시키는 것을 단기적인 목표로 일단 하고, 체제 위협이 더 없다고 판단되는 상황을 만들어 비핵화를 향해 가는 것을 장기 목표로 삼자”고 길게 설명했다고 전했다. 이에 트럼프 대통령은 “충분히 고민해보겠다”는 답을 했다고 한다.)

Regarding South Korea-U.S. shipbuilding cooperation, President Lee noted, "He (President Trump) mentioned it before, and this time he also asked me if we could quickly build 10 U.S. Navy ships. I replied that it's certainly possible and we'll do our best." President Lee mentioned French President Emmanuel Macron in relation to how he ended up sitting next to President Trump at the official G7 dinner, saying, "He told me that he deliberately seated me next to President Trump at the dinner." (한미 조선 협력과 관련해, 이 대통령은 “(트럼프 대통령이) 전에도 한 번 말씀하셨는데, 이번에도 역시 미국 군함 10척을 빠르게 건조해 줄 수 있냐는 의사를 제게 물어봤다”며 “거기에 대해서 당연히 가능하고 최선을 다하겠다고 답했다”고 전했다. 이 대통령은 G7 공식 만찬 때 트럼프 대통령 옆자리에 앉게 된 배경과 관련해 의장국 정상인 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령을 언급하며 “일부러 만찬 자리에서 트럼프 대통령과 자리를 붙여줬다고 저한테 말씀하셨다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee stated that during his overseas trip, he asked Pope Leo XIV "to visit South Korea on the occasion of the World Youth Day held in Seoul next year, and requested that he use the visit as an opportunity to tour the DMZ and, if possible, promote a visit to North Korea." President Lee added, "The Pope said he would actively consider and work toward it." President Lee held a one-on-one meeting with Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican on the 15th (local time). (한편, 이 대통령은 순방 기간 중 레오 14세 교황에게 “내년 서울에서 개최되는 세계 청년대회를 계기로 방한을 요청했고, 방한을 계기로 DMZ 방문과 가급적이라면 북한 방문도 추진해 달라고 요청했다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “교황께서도 적극적으로 고려하고 추진해 보겠다는 말씀을 하셨다”고 전했다. 이 대통령은 지난 15일(현지 시각) 바티칸 교황청에서 레오 14세 교황과 단독 면담을 가졌다.)

President Lee asked Pope Leo XIV to appoint a current cardinal responsible for domestic affairs, and introduced, "Contrary to expectations, he hasn't appointed a single cardinal yet, but he said that if he were to newly appoint a cardinal in the future, he would give special consideration to Korea's circumstances." (이 대통령은 레오 14세 교황에게 국내 업무를 담당하는 현직 추기경을 임명해달라고 요청하면서 “예상과 달리 본인이 추기경을 임명한 사람이 아직 한 명도 없는데, 앞으로 만약에 새로 추기경을 임명하게 된다면 한국의 사정을 각별히 고려하겠다고 말했다”라고 소개했다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo, Defeated in Election, Eyed for Presidential AI Committee?… Opposition Calls It "Revolving Door Appointment" (선거 떨어진 하정우, 대통령직속 AI委로?… 野 “돌려막기 인사”)
item.description:
It was reported on the 19th that President Lee Jae-myung is actively considering Ha Jung-woo, former senior presidential secretary for AI and future strategy at the Blue House, who ran as the Democratic Party candidate in the June 3 by-election for Busan's Northern Gap district and lost, for the full-time vice chairmanship of the National AI Strategy Committee, a body under the direct control of the president. The People Power Party criticized this as "the Lee Jae-myung administration's revolving door appointment" and demanded an immediate withdrawal. (이재명 대통령이 민주당 후보로 6.3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마했다가 떨어진 하정우 전 청와대 AI미래기획수석을 대통령 직속 국가AI전략위원회 상근 부위원장에 유력 검토하는 것으로 19일 알려졌다. 국민의힘은 “이재명 정권의 ‘돌려막기식 회전문 인사’”라며 “당장 철회해야 한다”고 했다.)

Former senior secretary Ha stepped down from his post in April to run in this by-election. Having entered the Blue House from Naver, he resigned just about 10 months later to seek a seat in the National Assembly. However, if this appointment goes through, he would return as a "presidential aide" just over two weeks after losing the election. (하 전 수석은 이번 보궐선거 출마를 위해 지난 4월 수석직을 내려놨다. 네이버 출신인 그가 청와대에 들어온지 10개월여만에 국회 입성을 위해 사표를 낸 것이었다. 하지만 이번에 인사가 나면 낙선한 지 불과 보름여만에 다시 ‘대통령의 참모’로 복귀하게 된다.)

Notably, the full-time vice chairmanship of the Presidential National AI Strategy Committee, for which Ha’s name is being floated, was held until recently by Rep. Im Moon-young of the Democratic Party, who won the by-election in Gwangju's Gwangsan-eul district. Even within the Democratic Party, there are murmurs: "Are we so short on AI experts that we have to recycle them?" (특히 하 수석 이름이 거론되는 대통령 직속 국가AI전략위원회 상근 부위원장직은 이번 광주 광산을 보궐선거에 나가 당선된 임문영 민주당 의원이 직전까지 맡았던 자리다. 민주당에서도 “AI 관련한 전문가가 얼마나 부족하면 돌려 쓰겠냐”는 말이 나온다.)

President Lee has frequently demonstrated a personnel management style of reusing former appointees in different roles. Most recently, he nominated Minister of SMEs and Startups Han Sung-sook as the next prime minister. In the recent by-elections, a considerable number of former Blue House officials ran as candidates. Former Digital Communication Secretary Kim Nam-guk, former spokespersons Kim Nam-joon and Jeon Eun-soo were elected and entered the National Assembly, while former Senior Political Affairs Secretary Woo Sang-ho won the Gangwon Province governorship, and former National Unity Secretary Office administrator Son Hwa-jung was elected as mayor of Yeongjong-gu, Incheon. A ruling party insider remarked, "For former senior secretary Ha, who ran under the 'Lee Myung-pick' label, returning immediately after losing looks bad. In the long run, it could also burden the Blue House." (이 대통령은 한번 기용했던 사람을 자리만 바꿔 다시 쓰는 용인술을 자주 보이고 있다. 최근엔 한성숙 중소벤처기업부 장관을 후임 국무총리 후보자로 내정했다. 특히 이번 선거에는 청와대 출신 상당수가 출마하기도 했다. 김남국 전 디지털소통비서관, 김남준·전은수 전 대변인 등은 보궐선거에 나가 당선돼 여의도 입성에 성공했고, 우상호 전 정무수석은 강원지사에, 손화정 전 국민통합비서관실 행정관은 인천 영종구청장에 각각 당선됐다. 한 여권 관계자는 “명픽으로 출마한 하 전 수석의 경우 낙선 후 바로 복귀는 모양새가 좋지 않다”며 “길게 보면 청와대에도 부담이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon issued a statement on the same day, criticizing, "The president's stubbornness in pushing through an opportunistic appointment that even within the ruling party draws head-shaking only confirms how severely the talent pool of this administration has been depleted." (최보윤 국민의힘 수석대변인은 이날 논평을 내고 “여당 안에서조차 고개를 가로젓는 기회주의적 인사를 밀어붙이려는 대통령의 고집은 이 정권의 인재풀이 얼마나 처참하게 고갈됐는지를 스스로 방증할 뿐”이라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae Silent on Lee’s Briefing, Visits Honam (李 브리핑에 침묵한 정청래, 호남 찾아가)
item.description:
When President Lee Jae-myung called a press conference on the 19th and appeared to target Chung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, with his remarks, pro-Lee factions said, "With the President going this far, can Representative Chung really dare to seek reelection as party leader?" However, Representative Chung is reportedly likely to resign as party leader next week and formalize his candidacy for the August party convention. (이재명 대통령이 19일 기자회견을 자청해 정청래 더불어민주당 대표를 겨냥한 듯한 발언을 쏟아내자, 친명계에선 “대통령이 이렇게까지 했는데 정 대표가 과연 당대표 연임 도전에 나설 수 있겠냐”는 말이 나왔다. 하지만 정 대표는 다음 주 당대표직을 사퇴하면서 8월 전당대회 출마를 공식화할 가능성이 큰 것으로 전해졌다.)

At the party meeting that morning, Representative Chung praised the President’s overseas trip for the third consecutive day, saying, "The President is world-class." Later, he visited the Democratic Party’s stronghold of North Jeolla Province, touring Jeonju, Gunsan, and Iksan. The itinerary was not publicized, but in the evening, Chung posted related photos on Facebook, writing, "I felt sorry, grateful, and appreciative upon hearing words like, 'You've worked hard as party leader. Hang in there.'" However, there was no mention of the President’s remarks that day. A Democratic Party official commented, "With the ruling camp divided over Representative Chung’s reelection as party leader, he must be deeply troubled." (정 대표는 이날 오전 당 회의에서 “대통령은 월드클래스”라며 사흘째 대통령 순방 성과를 치켜세웠다. 이후엔 민주당 텃밭인 전북을 찾아 전주, 군산, 익산을 돌았다. 이 일정은 비공개였는데, 정 대표는 이날 저녁 페이스북에 관련 사진을 올리며 “‘당대표가 참 고생이 많았제. 힘내시오’란 말씀을 들으면서 죄송하고 감사하고 고마웠다”고 썼다. 다만 이날 대통령 발언에 대한 언급은 없었다. 민주당 관계자는 “정 대표도 자신의 당대표 연임을 두고 여권이 분열하고 있는데 고민이 크지 않겠느냐”고 했다.)

Nevertheless, Chung is known to have decided to run. A Democratic Party figure close to Chung said, "The more the President acts like this, the more he has no choice but to run," adding, "While lawmakers try to dissuade him, party members' demands are only growing." Chung is also reported to have told those around him, "If I don’t run, it could spark controversy over interference in party affairs, harming the President." On the other hand, pro-Lee factions continued to pressure Chung not to run on that day as well. Lawmaker Chung Jin-wook stated, "The Democratic Party’s approval rating is falling because those who should take responsibility are not doing so." A key pro-Lee figure remarked, "Representative Chung, pretending not to hear the President’s message, held a campaign for reelection as party leader in Honam today." <<> When Representative Chung formalizes his bid for reelection as party leader, he is expected to continue sending messages to hardline supporters while emphasizing that he will be a party leader dedicated to the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. A senior lawmaker said, "If Representative Chung, backed by hardline supporters, pushes ahead with his candidacy despite the President’s remarks, as the President said, it will be not a ‘competition’ but a ‘war.’" (하지만 정 대표는 출마 쪽으로 가닥을 잡은 것으로 알려졌다. 정 대표와 가까운 민주당 인사는 “대통령이 저럴수록 출마를 더 할 수밖에 없다”며 “의원들은 말려도 당원들의 요구는 더 커지는 상황”이라고 했다. 정 대표도 주변에 “내가 불출마하면 오히려 당무 개입 논란이 일어서 대통령에게 피해가 갈 수 있다”고 말한 것으로 알려졌다. 반면 친명계는 이날도 정 대표의 불출마를 압박했다. 정진욱 의원은 “민주당 지지율이 떨어지는 것은 책임질 사람이 책임지지 않고 있기 때문”이라고 했다. 친명계 핵심 인사는 “정 대표가 대통령 메시지를 모른 척하며 오늘도 호남에서 당대표 연임을 위한 선거운동을 벌였다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Expresses Discontent with Opposition: "Bragging About Stock Index at 9,000? Don't Make Up Stories" (李, 야당에 불만 표출 “주가 9000 자화자찬? 없는 얘기 하지 말라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung revealed his discomfort on the 19th, saying, "When did I ever brag about the stock index reaching 9,000?" This was interpreted as a response to the People Power Party's criticism, based on remarks from their floor leader, that "the government is intoxicated by the KOSPI at 9,000 and bragging about it." (이재명 대통령은 19일 “내가 언제 주가 9000을 가지고 자화자찬했느냐”며 불편한 심경을 드러냈다. 이날 국민의힘이 원내대표 발언 등을 통해 “정부가 코스피 9000에 도취해 자화자찬한다”고 비판한 것을 겨냥한 발언으로 해석됐다.)

During the Cheong Wa Dae briefing that day, President Lee stated, "I've been cautious about discussing stock prices and deliberately avoided doing so. I have never once mentioned it. (When did I) brag about it reaching a certain thousand points?" He added, "Even if you attack me, don't fabricate false claims," and "Why are your expressions so cheap, slandering with baseless facts?" This directly targeted a comment made that day by People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik, who said in a party meeting, "The president and government, who bear infinite responsibility for state affairs, should not be intoxicated by the KOSPI at 9,000 and bragging." <<> President Lee remarked, "I have a concern. Polarization in the stock market leads to severe asset polarization." He continued, "It would be good if everything could grow together, but that's not easy. Still, just because someone bragged, can you make up stories that aren't true?" He then added, "Whether between the ruling and opposition parties or within a party, I hope political debates are competitions, not wars." <<> Addressing both sides, he said, "If you have rational debates based on facts, the public will think, 'Who's right?' or 'Who's cooler?'" He added, "When you resort to slander like this, don't emotions get hurt?" He also noted, "This isn't politics; it's a brawl. How uncomfortable must it be for the public to watch?" <<> Although President Lee said that day, "Did I brag about reaching a certain thousand points?" he has previously mentioned the KOSPI's rise on several occasions. In a June video on "Lee Jae-myung TV" titled "KOSPI at 8,000, Still Undervalued, Right?" President Lee remarked, "It has risen tremendously" and "It became like this in just six months." On the same day, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae also said in a party meeting regarding the KOSPI surpassing the 9,000 mark, "This is the result of the government's strong will to normalize the stock market." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “주가 얘기는 조심스러워서 일부러 하지 않고 있었다. 일체 한 번도 언급한 일이 없다. (내가 언제) 몇 천 포인트 됐다고 막 자랑했나”라고 했다. 그러면서 “저를 공격하더라도 없는 얘기를 만들어서 하지 말라”며 “표현은 왜 그리 저렴하며 없는 사실로 음해를 하나”라고도 했다. 이날 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표가 당 회의에서 “국정에 무한한 책임을 진 대통령과 정부는 코스피 9000에 도취하고 자화자찬할 때가 아니다”라고 한 것을 직격한 것이다.)

item.title: Investigation recommends prosecution of 12, including Noh Tae-ak and Wi Cheol-hwan: "NEC needs near-dissolution-level reform" (노태악·위철환 등 12명 수사 권고 “선관위, 해체에 가까운 혁신 필요”)
item.description:
The Central Election Commission's (NEC) Fact-Finding Committee, which investigated the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, recommended on the 19th that the NEC request an investigation into 12 individuals, including former NEC Chairman Noh Tae-ak and Acting Chairman Wi Cheol-hwan. The committee stated, "Given the overall inadequacy of the election management system, a sweeping reform approaching the dissolution of the NEC is necessary," and also proposed various measures. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 조사한 중앙선거관리위원회 진상규명위원회가 19일 노태악 전 중앙선관위원장과 위철환 위원장 직무대행 등 12명에 대해 중앙선관위에 수사 의뢰를 권고했다. 진상규명위는 “선거관리 시스템의 총체적 부실 상황을 볼 때 선관위 해체에 가까운 대대적 혁신이 필요하다”며 각종 대책도 냈다.)

Fact-Finding Committee Chairman Cho Hyun-wook announced this during a final briefing held at the NEC in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province. The 12 individuals recommended for investigation include former Chairman Noh, Acting Chairman Wi, and former NEC Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon (ministerial rank). The joint prosecution and police investigation team, currently operating under President Lee Jae-myung's directive, has already booked former Chairman Noh and former Secretary-General Heo as suspects and imposed a travel ban. The committee also recommended disciplinary action against six NEC staff members, including those from the Seoul Metropolitan and Songpa District Election Commissions. <<> According to the committee, on the day of the local elections, 140 out of 14,288 polling stations nationwide expected a shortage of ballot papers and received additional supplies. Among these, 91 polling stations actually used the additional ballots, and voting was temporarily halted at 26 stations. (조현욱 진상규명위원장은 이날 경기 과천 중앙선관위에서 활동 종료 보고 브리핑을 열고 이같이 밝혔다. 수사 의뢰 권고 대상은 노 전 위원장과 위 대행, 허철훈 전 중앙선관위 사무총장(장관급) 등 12명이다. 현재 이재명 대통령의 지시로 가동 중인 검·경 합동수사본부가 노 전 위원장과 허 전 사무총장 등을 피의자로 입건하고 출국금지 조치를 내린 상태다. 진상규명위는 중앙선관위와 서울시선관위, 송파구선관위 실무자 6명에 대해선 징계를 권고했다.)

As a preventive measure, the committee pointed out that the current part-time position of NEC Chairman should be converted to a full-time role. It also noted that, following last year's Constitutional Court decision, the NEC was excluded from the Board of Audit and Inspection's (BAI) scope of work audits, and stated, "There is a need to improve the system so that the NEC is included within the BAI's scope of work audits." The six-member committee, composed of external experts, concluded its activities today after a nine-day investigation that began on the 10th. (진상규명위에 따르면 지방선거 당일 투표용지 부족이 예상돼 추가 투표용지를 송부받은 투표소는 전국 1만4288개 투표소 중 140곳이다. 그중 추가 송부받은 투표용지를 실제 사용한 투표소는 91곳이며, 잠시라도 투표 중단이 발생한 투표소는 26곳이다.)

item.title: Lee tells opposition: "Don't fight like enemies" (李, 與 겨냥 “원수 싸우듯 하지 마라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 19th, addressing the Democratic Party of Korea, "Don't fight like enemies," and added, "How can people within the same camp fence compete not in a rivalry but in a war?" While this remark was made with the overheated race for party leadership ahead of the August party convention in mind, pro-Lee factions interpreted it as "a message directed at Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, who is widely expected to challenge for a second term as party leader." <<> During a briefing on the outcomes of his European tour at the Cheong Wa Dae Chancery on the same day, President Lee faced a question about party- presidential office conflicts and said, "I really want to say a word about the competition and conflict within the Democratic Party." He added, "Insulting, slandering, making up false facts to attack, then claiming unfairness—why do that? What if you fight as if to kill and actually kill someone?" <<> Regarding the declining approval ratings for both the president and the ruling party after the local elections, President Lee directly targeted party leadership, including Representative Jeong, who had declared a 'victory' in these elections, saying, "Approval ratings have been plunging since election day." He stated, "The public has every right to be angry. They're struggling to make a living, and they wonder what all the fighting is about." <<> Following the president's remarks, pro-government communities saw posts like, "Isn't this ultimately telling Representative Jeong to give up his bid for party re-election?" There was also a flood of comments saying, "The president is craftily intervening in party affairs to push for Prime Minister Kim Min-seok as the next party leader." The ruling camp's support base appeared to deepen divisions, with pro-Lee and pro-Jeong supporters exchanging harsh words against each other. <<> Although the president's briefing that day was intended to personally explain the outcomes of his European tour, including attendance at the G7 summit, there were also interpretations that he directly stepped in with the internal party situation in mind. A ruling party official remarked, "He already held a nearly three-hour press conference on the 8th, right after the local elections, for his first anniversary in office. It's unusual for the president to personally hold another two-hour press conference the day after returning from a tour." (이재명 대통령은 19일 더불어민주당을 향해 “원수 싸우듯이 하지 마라”며 “같은 진영 울타리 안에 있는 사람들끼리 경쟁이 아니라 전쟁을 해서야 되겠느냐”고 말했다. 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 과열되고 있는 당권 경쟁을 염두에 둔 발언이었지만, 친명계에선 “당대표 연임 도전이 확실시되는 정청래 대표를 향한 메시지”라는 해석이 나왔다.)
